prompt: fish shell IFS empty string effect command substitution
answer:
In fish, setting `IFS` to an empty string disables newline splitting in command substitutions:

```fish
set IFS ''
set var (some_command)
```

Unlike other shells, fish normally splits command-substitution output only on newlines—not on spaces, tabs, or the characters in `IFS`. With `IFS` empty, newline splitting is disabled, so the output is kept together. This behavior is deprecated; use `string collect` instead:

```fish
set var (some_command | string collect)
```

Setting or unsetting `IFS` is specifically described as disabling command-substitution splitting. (Fish documentation: https://fishshell.com/docs/current/language.html)
